interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area (0040:0049, 0040:006C) and GOAL.EXE data-segment words (DS:7B62, DS:7B64, DS:8336, and two known strings) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
a savestate is written at each read, and one is loaded (Host+L) at the start (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2; neutrality not tested)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 35cb47faca49c4f8e17f3c0176a975337e56f80ad88fe8dc592c1ede2a88237c) with C: mounted from the folder the savestate was made with, recreated from the verified release copy; GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads the savestate whose sha256 is given; polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); DOS time not controlled
